name: Sovos / Saphety

sandbox.notes: Self-serve account creation, sandbox docs at dcn-solution.saphety.com/.../api-docs. REST. 'Free of charge' in their own words; production needs a paid subscription.

provenance.resolutionNote: Researched 2026-09-23 as a free-sandbox candidate for the French accredited-platform role, but this session never independently confirmed DGFiP registration or built any code against it -- capabilities are all false because no transport exists yet.

notes: Saphety originates as a Portuguese e-invoicing vendor, later acquired by Sovos -- listed here in the FRENCH accredited-platform-candidate context it was researched in, not as a claim about Portuguese coverage.
